text:
Still declined after the epic landed, and phase 3 strengthened rather than weakened the case.

Both reopen conditions are unmet. String-literal formulas outside tests: still zero. And the errors a macro cannot reach are now measurably better without it — the four semantic mistakes it could never catch (unknown column, wrong column shape) return MissingColumn and InvalidColumnType structurally, so the gap a macro was meant to close narrowed on its own.

The typed path also got more usable in passing: ModelFormula's own fields are ids now, so a directly-constructed formula is checked at its edges rather than at first use.
